visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a panning shot of a bicycle docking station in Okayama, Japan. Several pink and lime-green shared bicycles with wire baskets are parked in metal racks on a dark patterned pavement. A white electronic kiosk with a large screen stands in the background under bright, natural daylight. (2) The scene transitions to a digital screen recording of the MOMOchari mobile website interface. A user selects the Traditional Chinese language option and scrolls through detailed terms of service and usage instructions. Text input fields are shown where the user types registration information including name and phone number. (3) The focus shifts to a physical rental kiosk station. A hand is seen interacting with the touch screen, navigating through menus to complete the formal registration process. The screen displays a numeric keypad for code entry. A smartphone is then placed against a dedicated IC card reader area to bind the account. (4) A person wearing dark clothing and a backpack is briefly seen from a distance riding a lime-green bicycle down a narrow, paved residential street lined with traditional wooden houses and greenery. The sky above is clear blue, indicating sunny weather. (5) A hand demonstrates the bike's locking mechanism. A physical key is inserted into a black lock on the front wheel frame, and a metallic sliding bar is moved to secure the wheel. The video concludes with the hand placing the bicycle key into a small black mailbox-style return box mounted on a wall.

(4) [Variety]: 第一步 先到網站上登錄資料. (5) [Variety]: 第二步 確認使用方式、相關規定. (6) [Variety]: 第三步 勾選同意，然後下一步. (7) [Variety]: 第四步 輸入姓名、國籍、電話 (可輸入台灣手機號碼). (8) [Variety]: 第五步 非常重要 一定要輸入信用卡資料 外國人只能使用信用卡付款. (9) [Variety]: 都完成後 會得到一組帳密 然後要到這台機器正式註冊. (10) [Variety]: 有中文可選，不用擔心. (11) [Variety]: 點選「登錄」然後「正式登錄」. (12) [Variety]: 接著輸入 登錄時得到的帳密. (13) [Variety]: 最後一步 需要用自己的交通卡感應這裡 然後才是完成綁定. [Slogan]: SUICA、ICOCA都可以 手機卡、實體卡都行. (14) [Variety]: 完成後就能 租車到處逍遙了. (15) [Variety]: 鎖車示範 把前輪黑色地方拔直. (16) [Variety]: 向內壓到底 鑰匙就會彈出 可暫停去購物或吃飯. (17) [Variety]: 解鎖示範 鑰匙放進去後 推到底往下壓 就能解鎖繼續騎. (18) [Variety]: 記得要把鑰匙放到這個箱子內唷.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track begins with a bright, cheerful background music track featuring a bouncy acoustic piano melody accompanied by light, pizzicato strings. The tempo is brisk and consistent, creating a welcoming and helpful atmosphere for the tutorial. A faint urban background hum is barely audible. (2) A sharp, mid-frequency digital 'pop' sound effect occurs at the 5-second mark, precisely marking the transition to the website screen recording. This transient sound functions as a navigational cue, maintaining high clarity against the melodic music bed, which continues without interruption. (3) A sequence of rhythmic, dull 'thud' or 'tap' sound effects is heard between 15 and 21 seconds. These represent the physical impact of a finger against the kiosk's glass touch screen. They are dry, short-duration sounds with minimal reverb, indicating a close-mic capture. (4) At the 22-second mark, a clear, high-pitched digital 'chime' or 'ding' sounds. This is a post-production or device-native sound effect signifying a successful IC card scan. It has a bright spectral centroid and a smooth harmonic decay that stands out clearly. (5) As the bike is shown being locked, a series of metallic 'clinks' and 'sliding' sounds are heard. These high-frequency transients represent the physical movement of the steel lock mechanism. They are sharp and realistic, providing a tactile auditory sense to the visual demonstration. (6) A final metallic 'snap' sound occurs at 26 seconds as the key is ejected from the lock, followed by a resonant metallic 'clack' at 30 seconds as the lid of the key return box is closed. The upbeat piano music fades out quickly at the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Step-by-step Registration -> Physical Binding -> Usage Demo -> Final Disposal.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a comprehensive, easy-to-follow visual guide for tourists on how to register for and use the MOMOchari public bicycle sharing system in Okayama City, Japan.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high density of Traditional Chinese text overlays to cater to tourists from Taiwan or Hong Kong. The fast-paced editing and bright music make the bureaucratic process of registration seem approachable and simple.
